title: Zombie _stakers entries monotonically inflate owner flush gas cost
description: The normal withdraw path removes a staker from the _stakers EnumerableSet on full exit (L658-660). pauseWithdraw reduces user.amount to zero (L542) but never calls _stakers.remove, leaving zero-value residual entries that break the implicit membership <=> amount>0 invariant.
impact: Correctness-harmless (zombies visited with pending==0), but the _stakers set grows monotonically; batchClaim iterates to flushCursor==_stakers.length() so every zombie permanently inflates owner flush gas. Owner-borne, slow accumulation, not cheaply attacker-driven (needs pause window + prior >=MINIMUM_STAKE stake).
recommendation: Mirror the withdraw full-exit logic: when post-withdraw user.amount==0 in pauseWithdraw, call _stakers.remove(msg.sender).
